request: On a new branch, test out each of the skills autonomously using your best judgement using Sol 6.2 high subagents. I will be away from my computer so I will be unable to take action. Go with your gut and make your own decisions. I want to come back and be able to review all of the changes that have been made to this project as a reasult of each of those skills. Start with the agent-scaffold skill before doing the other ones.
mode: autonomous independent task agents; isolated game and skill worktrees; parent integration review
constraints: locked camera in both motion settings
preserve accepted Cold Signal identity and private-room co-op loop
human taste, comprehension and comfort remain untested
no added cloud service or paid dependency
